approach: Static recompilation of the MIPS code to Odin on a reimplemented PS1, no BIOS; Vulkan renderer
notes: Runs on a reimplemented PS1 with no emulator core and no BIOS image. Adds hi-res Vulkan rendering, 60/120/240 Hz motion, a free third-person camera, seamless towns, faster doors and text, battle and balance options and restored cut content. Linux tested.
